verdict.rationale: Cooley AI is described as connecting AI to firm knowledge/workflows to give lawyers 'faster insights,' and S-1 drafts can be updated 'with a few simple prompts,' suggesting AI-generated insight/drafting capability exists — but this is aimed at Cooley's own lawyers, not end users interacting with their own data inside a self-serve product, and Cooley GO (the user-facing document/data product) shows no AI insight features. Missing for 10: evidence of end-user-facing AI insights/suggestions generated from a user's own data, concrete examples of the S-1 prompt-based updates, and any documentation of AI features in Cooley GO itself.
